data.turoyo: Komər annaqqa kərxənne tloṯo, arbʕo yawme bi walayaṯe, ḥozən am manazər di walaye w hežinu annaqqa gəmsafri, gəzzehən lu balad du babaṯṯe.
data.translation: Drei, vier Tage gingen sie erst in der Stadt spazieren, um die Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt anzusehen, dann machten sie sich auf die Reise und ritten nach der Stadt ihres Vaters.

rationale: Thin II Infectum cell (1 existing): third-person plural gəmsafri with a complete sightseeing-to-departure sequence contrasts with the inherited feminine singular msafro.

summary: The occurrence supports existing II.1 abreisen: an objectless departure followed by movement to the father’s city. The destination belongs to the following go-clause, so no special government is imposed on msafri.
The form is Infectum despite the German narrative past. The passage establishes narrative departure, but does not by itself decide every aspectual or modal value of gə-.

The Arabic III in the etymological heading is the donor-language pattern; the inherited Turoyo II filing remains unchanged. There is no evidence here for another stem, numbered sense, Detransitive form or fixed Idiomatic phrases item.
